model_selection: Candidate, C and weights frozen before this evaluation; previous validation is calibration training data; no fresh labels used for fitting
fresh_overlap_check: No recording ID, speaker hash or transcript hash shared with any previous split
evaluation_kind: Agreement with automatic CTC labels, not human-verified mouth shapes; breathing uses weak clip labels from uploader descriptions. Natural breaths within speech are not exhaustively annotated.
breath_decision: 90th percentile over source activity / non-silence teacher labels; fixed threshold .5; raw and actual gate/smoothing reported separately
